package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type TeacherContextSummaryRepository interface {
	Latest(ctx context.Context, scope domain.TeacherContextScope) (domain.TeacherContextSummary, bool, error)
	Store(ctx context.Context, update domain.TeacherContextSummaryUpdate) (domain.TeacherContextSummary, bool, error)
	Invalidate(ctx context.Context, scope domain.TeacherContextScope, expectedThroughSequence int64, at time.Time) (bool, error)
}

type TeacherContextMutationApplyResult struct {
	Processed   bool
	Advanced    bool
	Invalidated bool
}

type TeacherContextMutationStore interface {
	ApplyMutation(ctx context.Context, mutation domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation, processedAt time.Time) (TeacherContextMutationApplyResult, error)
}

type TeacherContextSummarizer interface {
	Summarize(ctx context.Context, input domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest) (domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload, error)
}
